subject: O eu, o outro e o nós
description_pt: Reconhecer seu corpo e expressar suas sensações em momentos de alimentação, higiene, brincadeira e descanso.

components.description_pt: Reconhecer partes e características de seu próprio corpo em rotinas diárias
components.description_en: Recognize parts and features of their own body through daily routines
components.cc_component_description: Identify external body parts of animals and explain their functions for survival and movement

components.description_pt: Expressar sensações físicas vivenciadas durante alimentação, higiene, brincadeira e descanso
components.description_en: Express physical sensations experienced during feeding, hygiene, play, and rest
components.cc_component_description: Represent emotions experienced while solving problems through expressive communication

cc_matches.description: All organisms have external parts. Different animals use their body parts in different ways to see, hear, grasp objects, protect themselves, move from place to place, and seek, find, and take in food, water and air. Plants also have different parts (roots, stems, leaves, flowers, fruits) that help them survive and grow.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán expresar explicaciones para...
* detallar los procesos que se siguen al aprender
* representar sus emociones al resolver problemas
* compartir su pensamiento inicial sobre ideas o conceptos
* describir ciclos en diagramas, pasos en procedimientos o causas y efectos
* comparar y contrastar objetos o conceptos
* ofrecer ideas y sugerencias
